title: How to make an extremely customized battle system?

posts.author: KDtheKiddo
posts.body:
This is my very first time making a game so I apologize if something similar has already been asked or if this is an unrealistic question, but I am hoping to make a battle system similar to this image I threw together really quickly.
This is my vision: The characters would move across the screen to attack each other with their own special animation for each skill. The blue buttons would disappear when those animations occur, and reappear when it’s finished. When they are idle, they would bounce up and down.
Would this be a basic side view battle just with increased sprite sizes? I have an idea on how to do the gauges and face (Battle HUD?), but I have no idea where to start when it comes to the blue buttons or animations.
This is more like a hopeful extra feature, but before the battle starts, I would want it to do a countdown with sound effects. Like a “3, 2, 1… FIGHT!” And have a picture come on to the screen for that.
Thank you for taking the time to read this post and for being patient with me

posts.author: Eliaquim
posts.body:
Hi there, and welcome
If you are just starting with RPG Maker and also does not have any knowledge with Javascript, forget about plugins.
Learn the engine first, all or at least most of what the engine can do by default. Then you fell you have enough knowledge about the engine, you can move to use plugins.
Make a battle system like that would require you either a lot of knowledge with events, by using pictures etc. Although possible, I really don't recommend.
or the other way around, that would be using plugins or coding with javascript.
The point is, this is kinda advanced if you are just starting. Try making things that are less advanced first.
If you still want to do anyways, here is some free plugins that can help you achieve that:
Rpg Maker MV

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
Danatoth said:
This would allow you to do that:
Luna Engine MV by Archeia
A script that modifies RPG Maker MV UI easily
archeia.itch.io
Click to expand...
I'd also say this is a very poor recommendation.
The documentation on this software is poor, the price is incredibly high, there is very little support; both first party and third party, so basically you are left to your own devices to figure it out yourself. And in order to do that;
It uses it's own custom scripting language, so you will need to learn how to use that scripting language. You will also need to be familiar with the existing scenes in RPG Maker and some of the deeper parts of the engine in order to properly build a UI using that tool. For someone just starting out, that is not a good idea.
Edit:
As for making larger sprites, there is no size limits, just formatting limits.
Please read the documentation on asset standards for how to format your sprite sheets.
Go to Help -> Contents -> Documentation -> Asset Standards

posts.author: darai
posts.body:
Listen to your peers. They protect you from harm.
"very first time making a game" means how good is your JS? No game in any other engine / language? Blank slate?
Don't get me wrong, I don't mock and I will not discourage you, I just try to envision what to expect from you so we can pick the right level of help.
You say you have no idea where to star with "The Blue Buttons" and "The Animations".
So if you are as green as you suggest, buckle up, this will be a wild ride with a lot of reading.
My advise: Add features one by one and test a lot, learn gradually and don't be afraid of mistakes they WILL come.
Now some plugin suggestions. All free, available for commercial use I believe.
Regarding Blue buttons I don't have many options but there is 'clickable picture' plugin from
Neoma Studi
o, that does the trick for me.
And regarding animations, the basic
Yanfly's Action Sequence Pack
series can do all you mentioned. Question is what else you will come with next. (Download it as the Starter free pack)
Guys I am very curious if you have better option for the buttons.
Now a little bit of propagation. I did a youtube short videos covering the topics you are talking about, so watch them if you have 10 minutes (only selecting the relevant ones to what you are seeking):
Image Buttons (Video about picture based main screen)
Action Sequences for begginers
Boss Fights
Also if you are NOT as green as you suggest, do you know that there is actually
documentation
for RMMV? Just for your future questions on custom code.
